name: 21755 · Jefferson, MD
findings: ZIP 21755 (Jefferson) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21755 (Jefferson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 21755 (Jefferson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
